_comment: FORCED (immutable) Claude settings subset. install_claude_skills.sh deep-merges this over the host-owned ~/.claude/settings.json on every run (see opt/scripts/system/apply-forced-settings.sh and docs/mbo/designs/2026-06-02-ai-config-home-provisioning.md). hooks/statusLine/permissions.deny/permissions.ask are REPLACED from the repo; permissions.allow is UNIONED (host additions preserved); every other host field is preserved. Hooks reference well-known $HOME paths populated by copy. gss push/pr/sync live in allow (not ask): they are auto-approved at the harness level but still gated by the safety_guard approval-token hook (which runs before permission checks) plus the gss skill's mandatory confirmation — so they no longer double-prompt.
